requirement: Create a suspected cause linking a pathogen to a severity and treatment site: the pathogen must exist and be live, the exact (pathogen, severity, treatment site) tuple must not already exist among live rows, then the command is mapped, persisted, and its id returned with Created status.

preconditions.text: The referenced pathogen exists and is live
No live cause already holds the requested tuple
A live cause already holds the exact tuple
The referenced pathogen is unknown or soft-deleted

inputs.text: Create the first cause for a pathogen, severity, and treatment site
Create request referencing a soft-deleted pathogen
Create the same tuple again after the previous row was soft-deleted
Same pathogen with a different severity or treatment site
Create request with an unknown pathogen id
Create request for a tuple that already has a live row

returns.text: Success with Created status and the new cause id
The cause is persisted with the requested pathogen, severity, and treatment site
Failure with BadRequest and the 'Pathogen ID not exists' error
Failure with BadRequest when the live tuple already exists

exception_text: No unhandled exception; every rejection is returned as a failed Result
